summary.text: Fang Yuan records variant human alliance contributions on a public ranking headed Contribution Board.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan subdued the variant human alliance, he stays in closed cultivation at Xia clan headquarters while Wu Shuai handles daily affairs. Members are summoned and pressured to offer Immortal Gu. Xiao He Jian offers a rank eight Gu. Green Forest Great Sage offers his wood path Immortal Gu. They then find a list pasted on an information path mortal Gu House, with two large words at the top. Xiao He Jian stands first, his contribution points in four digits. Green Forest Great Sage is in the top ten.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch learns of the ranking and worries that his name is absent, which is a poor showing for a vice alliance leader. He is reluctant to part with ice and snow path Immortal Gu, so he decides to gather immortal materials and offer those instead, aiming to be among the top.

Fang Yuan could force every subordinate to hand over Immortal Gu, but that would look too ugly and would waste the unity already gathered. Putting up the board eases conflicts and stimulates enthusiasm, while the essence remains the strong exploiting the weak.

On the same day, Eastern Sea’s righteous path appoints Qi Sea Ancestor as alliance leader of the Righteous Qi Alliance. His second task is to immediately create a contribution board and mission board, so that anyone who contributes to that alliance has their merits known.

Qi Sea Ancestor requires the Righteous Qi Alliance clans to contribute true inheritances against an ant plague, and names that alliance’s contribution board as the reward and compensation. The board had few names. As clans take inheritances out, it lengthens and the ranking competition intensifies. Qi Sea Ancestor assesses each inheritance’s value. Song clan reaches the top after Tian Nan’s true inheritance is judged the highest value among those contributed.
The scored currency those boards display is covered on Contribution Points.
